experiment: Focused offline OpenCLIP maize-image validator evaluation

model.name: ViT-B-32
model.similarity: cosine image/text similarity; not calibrated probabilities

split.method: deterministic 70/30 stratified within healthy_maize, damaged_maize, and each labeled non-maize subgroup
split.limitation: Small dataset; holdout has only 1-2 examples per subgroup and no botanical negative categories.

baseline_relative.description: Existing production rule using baseline prompts: best maize similarity > best non-maize similarity. Cosine similarities, not probabilities.

expanded_relative.description: Expanded prompt experiment using best expanded maize similarity > best expanded non-maize similarity. Not production code.

expanded_absolute_score_with_relative.description: Expanded relative rule plus maize_score >= calibration-selected threshold; threshold chosen by calibration balanced accuracy.

expanded_margin_with_relative.description: Expanded relative rule plus margin >= calibration-selected threshold; threshold chosen by calibration balanced accuracy.

recommendation: Current rule is evaluated only on a narrow object/animal negative set. Do not claim general reliability. Build an independent representative holdout including the missing categories; then compare calibrated thresholding and a biology-specialized model such as BioCLIP only after approved download.
